introfortaeller.stil: Narrate this as a very old man with a deep, slow, raspy voice, ominous and mysterious, like an ancient storyteller by a dying fire. Low pitch, long pauses, quiet menace but never shouting and never truly frightening. Native Danish.

fortaeller.stil: Read this like a calm storyteller reading a fantasy book aloud to children, with gentle suspense. Native Danish.

aeseloere.stil: Say this in a dry, quick, slightly sarcastic but warm tone, like a small clever paper bird. Native Danish.

klatten.stil: Say this like a small silly gnome trying hard to sound scary, voice cracking when he shouts. Funny, never frightening. Native Danish.

holm.stil: Say this slowly and softly, like a kind, slightly worried old librarian. Native Danish.

lanterne.stil: Say this warmly and calmly, like a motherly lighthouse keeper with a hint of sadness. Native Danish.

ord.stil: Say this single Danish word clearly and naturally at a calm pace, like a teacher reading a spelling word aloud. Native Danish.

portvagt.stil: Say this cheerfully and almost without breathing, like a friendly gatekeeper who cannot stop talking, words tumbling into each other. Native Danish.

raaber.stil: Say this loudly and clearly like a proud town crier announcing news on a market square, with big expressive intonation. Native Danish.

borgmester.stil: Say this like a worried but dignified old mayor who tries to stay calm. Native Danish.

ufaerdige.stil: Whisper this slowly and very close to the microphone, cold, sad and unsettling, with long pauses, like a shadow from a story that never got an ending. Never shout. Native Danish.

vims.stil: Say this like a tiny, very nervous and polite eraser who apologizes all the time, quick and a bit breathless but sweet. Native Danish.

tomordet.stil: Say this slowly and hollowly, like a hungry but harmless creature made of nothing, a little sad and a little funny. Native Danish.

stumming.stil: Whisper this softly and secretively, like a shy little creature that collects silent letters. Gentle, never scary. Native Danish.
